videos.title: Creation of my APA Pool Team's "Ball Busters" logo
videos.description:
Last fall 2021 I decided to join a 9 Ball pool armature league of the Northeast Mass APA Division just for fun. A couple of weeks ago my team decided to start an 8 Ball team in addition to our 9 Ball team since we did so well and made the playoffs. So they asked me to design a team logo for our APA (The American Poolplayers Association) league that would incorporate both 9 Ball & 8 Ball leagues. I decided to incorporate both teams into one Yin-Yang style logo and here it is!

videos.title: How NOT to use pastels drawing a Ford GT
videos.description:
I thought I'd try a new medium with soft pastels so I went to Michael's today and bought some by Artist Loft. But as expected I have no experience and made a mess of things. So I decided to show you guys how NOT to use them. I'm sure there are better applications to use them such as landscapes, or other forms of still art, etc. but these are not for detail work. At least I do not know how to use them correctly.
